entries.description: Caught my own MIGRATIONS.md claim that preventive ENTRIES over-count preventive ACTS by one. Backwards and wrong in magnitude — the flag under-counts 4x. The wrong statement was already committed in a document that INSTRUCTS THE AUDITOR how to tally, so it would have propagated into the scoring. Stopped before it was read.

PROTOCOL.md header still read 'Nothing in this file has been measured. No experiment has run.' a full day after E5 closed and E2 session 1 ran, and status.py faithfully reported 'E2 NOT STARTED' because it derives from that prose. A deriving tool inherits the staleness of its source; prose does not fail a build.

findings.description: AMENDMENT 3's preventive flag DOES NOT MEASURE PREVENTIVES: 3 entries flagged vs 13 whose descriptions name a decline/refusal/stop-before-execution. Under-counts 4x because the field is optional and never validator-required, unlike actor and via. Any tally from the flag alone is invalid.
